subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` contract for subagent completion routing?
rationale: The request is not a broken existing documented contract; it adds durable tool and config semantics in session-state and message-delivery code that repository policy treats as product and compatibility sensitive.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101248 or an equivalent implementation after its review blockers and real-behavior proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option for now and defer global/per-agent defaults until operator and upgrade semantics are reviewed separately.

options.title: Keep workaround behavior
options.body: Decline the new core contract and leave orchestration to explicit `sessions_send` or future parent-scoped handoff work.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101248 or an equivalent implementation after its review blockers and real-behavior proof gap are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool, owns much of the spawn/announce history, and previously described the focused implementation shape on this issue.
